scope: Team24 preliminary submitted anonymization v5; retrospective diagnosis with released truth; no new DP release

source_checks.chance_calibration: Official beta_chance reused; 20000-permutation calibration not rerun

selection_diagnostics.method: Select top163 by five-numeric-QI 3NN distance ratio to C versus A_bg; predict10, others11. TG/ALT log; A_bg std scaling. Fixed recipe, retrospective, not attacker-code reproduction.
selection_diagnostics.warning: No hyperparameter search; disclosed truth used only for evaluation. One challenge set and one heuristic cannot prove or exclude actual leakage.

earlier_toy_validation.warning: The stored v5 toy report evaluates a practice-world C, not the actual submitted C.

limitations: Published F files contain predictions, not attacker training code.
One realized DP release; cannot attribute a causal effect to a generation stage.
The known-truth diagnostic is retrospective, not held-out validation.
Attackers share the same released C and sampling world; independent-trial uncertainty is not assumed.
